name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Hodnoceni (Ratings) tab as its own Inertia page
description:
## Why?

Hodnoceni is not an in-page tab. It is a separate controller and a separate page (`PartnerServiceRatings`, section-map id 1118, slug `hodnoceni-partnerske-sluzby`) that the tab strip reaches through `ui-tab-external`, which does a full page navigation. It therefore needs its own Inertia page rather than a panel inside `PartnerServiceAdd`.

## What?

Rewrite `PartnerServiceRatings` as its own React/Inertia page with the shared tab strip. Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Ratings.tpl` (read-only table) and `sub/ServiceDetail/RatingModal.tpl` (reaction editing), then delete both legacy partials and `PartnerServiceRatings.tpl`.

Note `PartnerServiceRatingsController extends PartnerServiceAddController`, so the shell work from the first task has to be reusable across both pages. Ratings data comes from the marketplace database via `MarketplaceDbDriver`, not from the shop silo.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `'PartnerServiceRatings'` added to `cms/packages/Inertia/InertiaControllers.php` and the page renders React
- Table renders date, score stars, comment, author with IP and reaction, with sorting on `created` and `score` and working pagination
- Rating reaction modal edits and saves `reactionDescription` via `adminUpdateAction()?ratingId=`; `description` stays disabled
- Rating count in the tab label matches the legacy page
- Tab strip is shared with `PartnerServiceAdd` and both directions of navigation work
- `data-testid="inputRatingDescription"` and `data-testid="inputReactionDescription"` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `PartnerServiceRatings.tpl`, `sub/ServiceDetail/Ratings.tpl` and `sub/ServiceDetail/RatingModal.tpl` deleted
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceRatingsController.php:21,59,73`, `admin/controllers/templates/PartnerServiceRatings.tpl`, `sub/ServiceDetail/Ratings.tpl`, `sub/ServiceDetail/RatingModal.tpl:15,42`
- `cms/packages/Crm/Helper/ServiceRatingHelper.php:67,86,132,177,236`, `cms/packages/Layout/PaginationBackend`, `cms/packages/Layout/SortingBackend`
- Tab bridge: `sub/ServiceDetail/ServiceDetailTabs.tpl:23`, `public/cms/js/_repo-shared/main.js:149-153`
- Data: `st_pattern.ratings` via `MarketplaceDbDriver`, joined with `st_cms.projects` and `st_cms.tariffs`
